screenshots.name: old-rc13-update-available.png
screenshots.observation: 旧 RC13 显示发现 v0.1.0-rc.14、来源 RC13 和更新内容；截图恰在入场动画中，不能作为最终稳定态对比度的证据。

screenshots.name: old-rc13-downloading.png
screenshots.observation: 点击更新后的截图仍在原弹窗退场阶段，左下角已出现 0% 下载进度；不能以这一张静态图替代完整动效连续帧验收。连续帧由完整产品包覆盖。

screenshots.name: old-rc13-update-ready.png
screenshots.observation: 下载完成后原弹窗已关闭，左下角显示安装按钮；无错误弹窗，旧 RC13 身份仍明确，未自动安装。

limitations: The first two captures are transition snapshots, not a settled contrast or full animation acceptance. Final product packet separately verifies updater motion. Actual installer execution is excluded.
